The project

After a year locked in his house with no contact with anyone, Edgar finds himself in the middle of a pandemic that has killed thousands and shows no sign of stopping. He accepts an unusual invitation: to wait it out in a millionaire's underground mansion. I handled the English translation and was responsible for QA.

What I owned

  • The full English translation
  • QA across the project

Listed separately from my design and development work because it is a different discipline. It is here because localization and QA are real skills I have shipped with — and because translating a narrative game well means making judgement calls about voice, not just about vocabulary.
